decisions.reason: The reference class electrometer is a flagship shown on the home page and sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry expertise, so its visible commitment, investment and fit with the announced direction make withdrawal very unlikely.

The oncology risk management software builds on the established offer and has its own web page, and it supports the announced move toward integration and patient-safety prediction, so any slow early uptake would be read as a temporary adoption lag rather than a reason to withdraw it.
